title: Gathering & Gauging
body:
Now that we're floating around the PNW for a few, I thought I'd restructure the site here... This whole site is a journal and I'll break things up into chapters to keep things clean and orderly. Figured now that we've been back here a bit, we'd start a new chapter, and let the southwest map chapter stand on its own. 

It's been so nice to see family back here, get some great hugs in, see granny steadily getting back to full health. Time at the giant house with the Big Guy's fam was so nice. Man... it's so lush and green! 

Just got back to Bend to greet the Big Guy's mom and hang with her for a week or so. And then we're not quite sure what... Alaska has been on the menu, but there's also a hankering for stability, and living so frugally and just dumping money on student loans... I know that sounds bland, but the Big Guy figures he might as well while he can... Kinda like the year he took off drinking... maybe he takes a year to just throw money at the pit that's kept him from buying a home for so long. 

Anyway, just with all of this contemplation, wondering, and ruminating... seemed like a good time to start a chapter 2 of this journal. Maybe you all can help nudge us in a good direction in the poll (top menu bar)?
